items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: We were around Tyler Downey living there. I mean Della Shays and them.

ctx.x: She's what? I think it was a Charles DeVerny played trombone or something. Yeah, it's a big family.
A lot of them living, yeah. We were around Tyler Downey living there. I mean Della Shays and them.
Was this, didn't you play many spot jobs around during the time you were with Sam? Oh yeah. How do you play, I mean with other bands I'm talking about?
